name: Розовая волна
essence: A high-key, airy SaaS promo that sweeps through soft pastel desk-scapes and punches into giant hot-magenta type and bold wipes. Short bright scenes, macro type crops and a clean logo end-card give it a premium, playful, fast-cutting rhythm.
material_and_look: Bright, near-white surfaces washed in lilac and blush, with soft depth-of-field haze, halftone dot textures and floating paper-like cards and sticky notes. For our engine, use clean light fields with subtle dot texture and layered floating feature cards casting soft shadows.
colour_logic: Mostly pale lavender and off-white, with saturated magenta-pink saved for wipes, giant words and the logo, plus violet triangles as secondary accents. A single sky-blue moment adds contrast mid-video before it returns to white and pink.
type_and_layout: Heavy geometric sans set huge, often cropped past the frame edges (e.g. 'Rea'), alternating with small UI-style labels and centred headline-plus-subline lockups. Layouts are airy and centred, with chips and pill buttons under short headlines.
motion_quality: Energetic but smooth: elements drift and parallax in depth, and cards fly in on eased curves, with quick scale punches on keywords. Momentum is continuous and nothing sits still for long.
camera_and_transitions: Fast push-ins and pans give way to diagonal magenta circular wipes, plus hard cuts into macro type crops roughly every 0.7s. The video ends on a calm hold of the centred logo on light grey.
sound: An upbeat, bright electronic pop bed with whooshes on every wipe and crisp clicks on UI moments. A soft chime lands on the logo reveal.
description: A high-key, airy SaaS promo that sweeps through soft pastel desk-scapes and punches into giant hot-magenta type and bold wipes. Short bright scenes, macro type crops and a clean logo end-card give it a premium, playful, fast-cutting rhythm.
